EditTextPreference.dialogTitle: From what date to load transactions
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Enter your phone number, SMS code and ZEN.COM app passcode when requested. Your passcode is saved in this connection for automatic sign-in. If a selfie is required, complete verification in your browser, return to Zenmoney and close the face verification window to continue synchronization. Supports personal currency accounts with purchases, top-ups, fees, transfers, MoneySend credits, ATM withdrawals and currency exchanges. Refunds and cash deposits are not yet supported.
